scripts.build:production: pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:push && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/database build && test -f packages/database/dist/index.js && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/shared build && ls -laR packages/database/dist packages/shared/dist && pnpm --filter @propertymaster/backend build
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate deploy
